topic: A process that left its session's tree resolves to the operator
detail: SP-011 resolves a caller with no harness above it as the operator, the widest result. A session process that double-forks, or starts a process through launchctl submit, open or osascript, before orchd accepts its connection, gets that result without a fake harness or a pin. This is wider than the D-26 detached-harness case. SP-025 must not grant operator-level memory reads by resolution alone until SP-041 (or kernel evidence such as audit tokens) covers it.
note: Settled by the user on 2026-11-10: operator-scope reads need a terminal or Orch.app; see D-39 and SP-025.1.a7.
